label: GO step after a reward when choosing a2, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass), only when the reward input shown at D1 was 1 (prev_reward == 1, 100% of mass), and only when the policy picks a2 (model_act == 2, 100%; choice logit strongly negative). It is confined to the first ~40 trials of an episode: rate 5.5% in trials 0-9, falling to 0 after trial 40. In practice that means S2 is good, or the good state has not yet been determined. The predicate uses only observed inputs and the agent own choice (its policy argmax). On dev this covers 93% of activations and 96% of the activation mass, but precision is only about 0.29: many rewarded a2 GO steps early in the episode stay silent. Magnitude is highest on the first rewarded GO after an unrewarded trial and decays over a run of consecutive rewards (e.g. 0.98 then 0.17 then 0.09). Adding the condition that the trial before last was unrewarded raises precision to 0.53, but recall drops to 0.40 and mass recall to 0.57; covering this or the trial before it reaches F1 0.50. Never fires at D1 or D2, after an unrewarded trial, when choosing a1, or late in the episode (trials 50-99).
